name: Qualcomm AI Hub Model License
content: Qualcomm's QNN runtime is used under Qualcomm Innovation Center's AI Model Hub License (https://softwarecenter.qualcomm.com/api/download/software/licenses/ai_model_hub/v1/LICENSE.pdf), which allows it to be distributed in object code as part of an application, as it is here (it runs the text detector on a Snapdragon GPU).
